increment_paragraph: EVALUATION-PROFILES (pluggable-cards seam A, phase P1; user decision 2 of 2026-10-24) records every evaluation that pins figures as data: contract/evaluations/<name>/evaluation.json (policy live or frozen at an analyzer revision, route, source revision and submodules, inputs with digests, contract-set reference, baseline record, append-only baseline history, evidence version), with scripts/evaluation_profiles.py as the single authority for the schemas and the policy. Six frozen profiles pin the cycles and matrix rows at the revision their last report measured (cycle-17-cfl b26b4aa35, cycle-18-libevent bb76178d5, cycle-19-fluent-bit b92688d22, cycle-19-monkey-callbacks 016df072c, cmetrics-counter-configured 55145be4f, chunkio-core-configured 60eef72ac). Three live profiles, eight-home, fluent-bit-system and fluent-bit-tail-pause, got their first baseline from a fresh measurement of BASE 710021bd7. Every docs/cycles/CYCLE_*.md names one profile or none. CYCLE_18_LIBEVENT_VALIDATION.md is the exception: native_platform_matrix.qv pins its bytes, so it is bound in contract/evaluations/bindings.json, which also classifies every matrix corpus key. The Python suite checks the tree and, commit by commit, the policy. A frozen profile never changes. A live baseline moves only together with a reasoned baseline_history entry in the same commit, and a live input change counts as a re-base. The card defines the amendments field profiles[] and checks it with evaluation_profiles.py amendments. No analyzer code, contract, theorem or input selection changed. No test pinned corpus totals, so no Rust test changed. [Report](../../reports/evaluation-profiles/README.md).
status_paragraph: Evaluation profiles (EVALUATION-PROFILES): every pinned corpus, system or slice figure now belongs to one profile under contract/evaluations/. Cycles are frozen at their last measured revision. The three live profiles have a combined-main baseline measured on 710021bd7 (original pinned inputs, eight-home link map). eight-home: 185 units, 4,834 rows, 1,013 Safe / 3,812 Unknown / 9 provisional Unsafe, null 2,549 / 2,355 / 17. fluent-bit-system: 448 rows, 101 / 343 / 4, null 211 / 243 / 0. fluent-bit-tail-pause: 404 rows, 57 Safe / 4 Pending / 342 Unknown / 1 provisional Unsafe, null 190 / 216 / 0. Against AUDIT-CANONICAL-PATHS at fb5412930, corpus has four more Safe rows and system two more; the moved rows are not attributed. A live profile's figures move only with a recorded baseline and reason.

ledger.title: apply_amendments.py validates profiles[] only by shape
ledger.text: Found by EVALUATION-PROFILES, which defines the reserved amendments field profiles[]: the live evaluation profiles whose baseline the card's measured tip records. Every name must be a profile, none may be frozen, and against the card base the list must equal the live profiles whose baseline changed (scripts/evaluation_profiles.py amendments <file> --base <rev>). apply_amendments.py, owned by AMENDMENTS-SCHEMA, still checks only the name shape, so an integrator applying a card's amendments does not run this check. DISCHARGE: apply_amendments.py --check calls evaluation_profiles.check_amendments with the document's base, with a refusal test for an unknown, a frozen and an unlisted moved profile.

ledger.title: Measurement drivers do not read the evaluation-profile records
ledger.text: Found by EVALUATION-PROFILES. The live profiles eight-home, fluent-bit-system and fluent-bit-tail-pause now record their route, tracked inputs (with digests), untracked prepared compile databases (with digests) and link map, but every card still measures with a copied report driver (docs/reports/audit-canonical-paths/scripts/measure.py) that hard-codes the same inputs, and nothing verifies the untracked digests before a run. DISCHARGE: quirin-audit measure --profile <name> (MEASURE-TOOL) reads contract/evaluations/<name>/evaluation.json, refuses a run whose untracked inputs differ from the recorded digests, and emits figures equal to evaluation_profiles.py summarize, so compare and record consume its output directly.

ledger.title: Matrix corpus rows are bound to profiles but not derived from them
ledger.text: Found by EVALUATION-PROFILES. contract/evaluations/bindings.json classifies every key of the acceptance matrix corpus section, and a test refuses an unbound key, but the rows themselves stay hand-maintained: conditional_eight_home_cycle3, bound route by route to the three live profiles, still shows the W48 batch-5 figures (corpus 975 Safe) while the live baselines record BASE 710021bd7. DISCHARGE: build_matrix.py emits each bound row's profile name and policy and, for a live profile, the figures of its current baseline.json, so the row cannot drift from the profile.

ledger.title: Re-base the live evaluation profiles onto a newer Fluent Bit revision every one to two months
ledger.text: User decision 2 of 2026-10-24 (docs/plans/pluggable-cards/README.md section 3 A, corpus cadence): the live profiles eight-home, fluent-bit-system and fluent-bit-tail-pause follow the Fluent Bit repository, best effort every one to two months. EVALUATION-PROFILES recorded their first baselines on BASE 710021bd7 over Fluent Bit 66910c10a (corpus), 046accf6a (system) and 34155955e (tail-pause slice). The policy check treats a change of a live profile's tracked inputs as a re-base that must record the newly measured baseline, with its reason, in the same commit; the previous baseline stays in baseline_history. Frozen cycle profiles are never moved. DISCHARGE: recurring; each firing is a card that prepares the newer revision's inputs, re-reviews the pins whose sites changed (pin --check, C06.2), records the new baselines through evaluation_profiles.py record and names the date of the next firing.
